stemMd: A trapezoid has area 63 and parallel sides of lengths 7 and 11. What is its height?
explanationMd: Its area equals average parallel-side length times height. The average is 9, so h=63/9=7. This reverses the standard area formula.

distractorRationale.a: Forgets the factor one half in the area formula.
